title: Color shutter: a color-gated obstacle
summary: Color Shutter is a color-gated obstacle introduced in Version 573 that opens or blocks passages based on color conditions.

seo.title: Block Out Color Shutter Obstacle Guide
seo.description: Understand the Block Out Color Shutter obstacle and how to meet its color condition before the gated route opens.

rules: Color Shutter was added in Block Out Version 573 as a colorful new challenge.
The shutter's state depends on color conditions on the board, opening or closing a passage.
You must satisfy the color condition before the gated route becomes usable.
strategyPoints: Identify which color the shutter expects before committing blocks nearby.
Clear the required color first so the passage opens for the following moves.
Re-check the shutter after each clear, because its state can change.
avoidPoints: Do not push blocks through a shutter that has not met its color condition.
Do not assume the shutter stays open after one use if the condition resets.
Do not block the color the shutter needs with pieces you cannot move.
